limitations: Original decompiled source may not match packaged JAR, so 200 is source-declaration census, not measured runtime count.
Legacy 1.12 double slab IDs may be modern slab BLOCKSTATE, which is not a same-name registry path.
Legacy banner blocks currently lack same-named modern block registration; placeholder items do not establish in-world banner parity.
A registered block can have placeholder behavior/model; all exact IDs need separate functional/visual checks.
